item.title: Rallying Cry – September 8, 2026
item.description: Kenya offers hope to migrants with a temporary amnesty, Google’s AI weather model gets a major accuracy boost, EV batteries prove more durable than expected, and Africa secures a $5.1 billion fund to tackle energy and fertilizer shocks.
